name: test_login_otp_company_listing_logout
description:
TC-001: Verify end-to-end OTP login, Company Listing, and logout.

        Expected:
        - Login page displays the heading, email field, Continue button,
          and Continue with Google option, with Continue disabled.
        - Entering a valid email enables the Continue button.
        - Submitting the OTP navigates to the Company Listing screen.
        - The Company Listing screen shows the expected elements.
        - Logging out returns the browser to the login page.
